description: CereProc's CereVoice Cloud v2 REST text-to-speech, synthesising plain text or SSML with a named CereVoice or CereWave AI voice and streaming the audio by default.

meta.auth: Bearer token from GET /auth (Basic auth with CereProc account credentials).
meta.custom_lexicons: User lexicon and abbreviation files uploaded via /lexicon and /abbreviations.
meta.emotion_tags: happy, sad, calm, cross — in voices with emotional support.
meta.metadata: metadata=true returns a URL to XML with word, phone and mark timings.
meta.model_id_note: No model parameter: POST /speak takes a voice name. 'cerevoice-cloud' is the service name.
meta.sample_rate_note: Voices are listed at 24000 Hz; a requested sample_rate that is not available is up/downsampled.
meta.singing: POST /sing synthesises a song from a MusicXML sheet.
meta.streaming_note: streaming=true (default) streams the audio; streaming=false returns a URL to the audio file.
meta.vocal_gestures: Non-speech sounds (laughs, coughs, sighs…) via the <spurt> tag.

name: CereVoice Cloud

pricing.notes: £12.99 per 1,000,000 Cloud credits (1 credit = 1 character of input text); free tier of 10,000 characters per month for registered Cloud users. Larger volumes via sales.
